Subject: Venue & group airfare declined — virtual card limit hit / urgent payment path

Evelyn / Laura — quick heads up: two vendor charges for the Garnet Health onsite were declined this morning when we attempted to prepay: the Laurel Hall venue deposit ($12,000) and the group airfare block via TravelSmith ($7,500). Both vendors emailed with decline notices; invoice stubs attached.

Venue needs the deposit by EOD Dec 1 or they will release our date. Travel agency says they can hold tickets for 48 hours but need payment to lock fares.

Details: 
- Event: Garnet Health Systems — Enterprise Workshop (Dec 8-9)
- Venue deposit: $12,000 — The Laurel Hall (attached: laurelhall_deposit_invoice.pdf)
- Group airfare prepay: $7,500 — TravelSmith (attached: group_airfare_invoice.pdf)

We charged both to the standard onsite virtual card tied to the Garnet project, but the card hit a per-day spend ceiling set by card ops. Can finance either: (A) lift the virtual card daily limit temporarily to allow these two charges, or (B) do a manual ACH for the venue and agency and then reimburse the virtual-card ledger once the issuer clears?

If we go ACH, Laura can provide sign-off and vendor banking details — I've cc'd her. Appreciate a fast path; this is time sensitive.

Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Karthik Iyer | karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Thanks Karthik — I see the two invoices. Quick questions before I escalate to payments ops: 
1) Can you confirm full vendor bank details (ABA/IBAN) and W9 where applicable?
2) Is the total spend charged to the Garnet virtual card only, or are there other open preauthorizations we should be aware of for that card today?
3) Preferred path: temporary limit bump (fastest if issuer cooperates) OR manual ACH (we can run same-day if we have bank details but need PO / approval note).

If you authorize ACH, please confirm a written approval (reply OK-ACH) and route vendor banking info to finance-secure@redwood.com (secure form required). If you'd like me to request a temporary limit from the issuer, I will open a priority ticket — give me a thumbs up and I'll include the vendor names + amounts.

Evelyn
Finance Manager — Redwood Inference
